name: Vespid Dynamics Counter-Drone Electronic Warfare Kit CDEW-2
product_name: Vespid Dynamics Counter-Drone Electronic Warfare Kit CDEW-2
description: A portable electronic warfare kit designed to detect, track, and disable hostile drones through signal jamming, GPS spoofing, and direct electromagnetic pulse. The CDEW-2 includes a drone detection radar, a directional jammer that can sever the control link between a drone and its operator, a GPS spoofer that feeds false position data to cause the drone to fly to a designated capture zone, and a focused EMP emitter that can permanently disable drone electronics at up to 50 meters. Vespid sells the kit as defense against their competitors' drone platforms — and their own, for clients who want protection from all aerial threats.

specifications.info: severs control link at 500m; permanent disable

story_hooks: A CDEW-2 was used to capture a Vespid surveillance drone intact — the drone's data cache contained months of surveillance footage that Vespid claims was collected under legitimate authorization.

A modified CDEW-2 has been developed that does not disable hostile drones but instead takes control of them — the captured drones join the defender's network and can be turned against their original operator.
